title: Honeypot, verification, logs, mod-log and confessions
items: /honeypot traps spam bots and hacked accounts and removes them automatically
/verify adds a button or small-question gate before members get a role
/logs records message, member, role, channel, voice and ban events; /modlog sets the moderation log
/confess and /confession add anonymous confessions with optional review and moderator tools

title: Blue theme and better admin dashboard
items: New colors and fonts that match the bot's logo
Admin overview with a setup checklist and a bot permission check
Moderation case browser with filters and CSV export
Dashboard activity log and confession moderation pages
Settings pages for logs, honeypot, verification and confessions

title: New look and status tools
items: Redesigned every page for phones, tablets and desktops
Live status with 30-day uptime bars and an incident history
Command analytics with daily usage trends

title: Cleaner code, configurable AI chat
items: /chat now works with any OpenAI-compatible provider (AI_API_KEY, AI_API_URL, AI_MODEL)
Command usage is recorded per day for the analytics page
